title: Class 9 · Force and Laws of Motion — Numericals
phase: Class 9 · Force and Laws of Motion

problems.prompt: Calculate the force required to impart a velocity of 30 m/s in 10 s to a stationary car of mass 1500 kg.
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle kinematic equation se acceleration nikal lo, aur fir F = ma use karo.

solution_steps.narration: Kyunki car rest se start hui, initial velocity zero hai. Acceleration ka formula lagao.
Ab Newton ke second law se force calculate karo.
Mass aur acceleration ko multiply karo.

problems.prompt: A force of 5 N gives a mass m1 an acceleration of 10 m/s^2 and a mass m2 an acceleration of 20 m/s^2. What acceleration would it give if both the masses were tied together?
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle dono ka alag alag mass nikal lo, fir unhe add karke combined mass par same force apply karo.

solution_steps.narration: m1 calculate karo F = m * a use karke.
m2 calculate karo usi tarike se.
Dono mass ko add kar do.
Ab combined mass par naya acceleration nikalo.

problems.prompt: An object of mass 100 kg is accelerated uniformly from a velocity of 5 m/s to 8 m/s in 6 s. Calculate the initial and final momentum of the object. Also, find the magnitude of the force exerted on the object.
problems.attempt_hint: Momentum ke liye p = mv use karo aur force ke liye rate of change of momentum (F = (pf - pi)/t) use karo.

solution_steps.narration: Force nikalne ke liye change in momentum ko time se divide karo.
Values put karke final force nikalo.

problems.answer: Initial Momentum = 500 kg m/s, Final Momentum = 800 kg m/s, Force = 50 N

problems.prompt: A bullet of mass 20 g is horizontally fired with a velocity 150 m/s from a pistol of mass 2 kg. What is the recoil velocity of the pistol?
problems.attempt_hint: Law of conservation of momentum lagao. Initial momentum = Final momentum.

solution_steps.narration: Fire karne se pehle dono rest par hain, toh total initial momentum zero hoga.
Fire karne ke baad total final momentum bullet aur gun ka sum hoga.
Conservation of momentum ke mutabiq, initial aur final barabar hain.
Equation ko solve karke v2 (recoil velocity) nikalo.

problems.answer: The recoil velocity of the pistol is 1.5 m/s (the negative sign indicates the direction is opposite to the bullet).

problems.prompt: A truck starts from rest and rolls down a hill with a constant acceleration. It travels a distance of 400 m in 20 s. Find its acceleration. Find the force acting on it if its mass is 7 tonnes (1 tonne = 1000 kg).
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle s = ut + 0.5at^2 se acceleration nikalo, fir F = ma se force nikalo.

solution_steps.narration: Motion ka dusra equation use karo displacement nikalne wale formula se.
Values put karo, initial velocity zero hai isliye pehla term zero ho jayega.
Ab Newton's second law use karke force nikalo.

problems.answer: Acceleration is 2 m/s^2, Force is 14000 N.
